neighbours.label: a verb in a specialised sporting or trade sense: 'capitalized', 'skied', 'to shop' a refinery, 'shoot up'
fire: Once more Ohio capitalized and took the lead.
Evans skied to haul in the long pass.
The bank plans to shop the refinery to buyers.
Aim higher, then shoot up with the gun.
Later Toledo capitalized on two errors.
Moss skied to catch the touchdown.
Ford will shop its truck unit overseas.
Tilt back the barrel to shoot up.
quiet: Once more Ohio walked and took a rest.
Evans walked to pick up the long rope.
The bank plans to sell the car to buyers.
Aim higher, then look up with the glass.
Later Toledo rested for two days.
Moss walked to find the bus.
Ford will close its truck unit overseas.
Tilt back the chair to look up.

notes: Card: ' up' 12, ' capitalized' 2, ' shop' 2, ' score' 2, ' off' 2. Probes: ' capitalized' 0.68, 'ied' 0.57, ' shop' 0.57, ' up' 0.46, ' score' 0.20; 'walked' 0.13. The + pole is engulf and consume.
